question: Reroute question: original pairing 2 legs but due to delays and timing out, crew rest after first leg. Next day DH to resume original pairing. Is the DH reroute considered to be after a break in duty. We were informed of the reroute enroute to first destination. Essentially, is our reroute 150% or 200%? I can make a case for either side. question: What is the current requirement for OE notification? Is it a phone call, or can it be done by CNO? It used to have to be a phone call.  I’m curious where ALPA landed on this. Used to be they could use CNO while you were still in the sim and after you were done it was phone contact. But we also had an agreement that they had to give you a ‘reasonable’ amount of time to prepare if you were already done in the sim, and that’s now been reduced to 30 hours. Unless you’ve been out of the sim for 10 days, then it goes to 48 hours, proffer down to 30. They cover notification in detail in the SRH for Section 23 stuff, they really need to clarify this in the TRH.
